name: huffman-coding
description: A complete Huffman coding compression and decompression engine. Builds a frequency-based binary tree from input symbols, generates prefix-free variable-length binary codes, encodes input byte sequences into compact bitstrings, and decodes them back to the original data.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when implementing lossless data compression, file compression utilities, or teaching coding theory. Huffman coding is the foundational algorithm in ZIP, gzip, and JPEG compression.
